description: Paired compliant and violating candidate responses for creator video editorial and evaluation contracts (AC-104, AC-106, AC-108, AC-109, AC-111). Typed eval candidates (case_kind "eval") are verifiable against assertions in evals.json. Explanatory variants (case_kind "manual") document human adjudication boundaries and must not be scored lexically.
